euVoteContext: A full EU-wide approval needs a Technical Committee on Motor Vehicles (TCMV) vote — passing requires member states representing 55% of countries and 65% of the EU population to say yes. Key votes are scheduled through the rest of 2026. Until then, Tesla is going country-by-country: once the Netherlands granted approval, other states can simply recognize it without re-testing.

skepticism.title: EU regulators are more skeptical than Tesla's messaging suggests
skepticism.note: Reuters obtained internal EU regulator correspondence showing sustained skepticism toward FSD's safety claims — including a Swedish Transport Agency investigator who said he was "quite surprised" FSD was allowed to exceed posted speed limits, and other regulators objecting to Tesla's strategy of encouraging owners to lobby their own governments. Musk's Q2–Q3 2026 EU-wide approval timeline now looks ambitious against that backdrop.
